items.title: 68239_Ram Ramirez oral history interview
items.q: The term 'Piano player' is used by the interviewer to address the interviewee (Ram Ramirez) and by the interviewee to refer to himself in the third person ('Piano player runs for job'). No other specific piano player is mentioned as a distinct entity with whom the interviewee has a relationship.

ctx.x: You were a very experienced piano player by this time. But was it hard to switch over to organ?

Well, yes, in a way. If you played piano... If you didn't play a good piano, it would be a cinch for you to play that hot Jazz organ. But I mean, when you... At that time, when you were a piano player, that's...you know... It was such a tremendous... The thing is to divorce yourself from the percussive sound to another sound. And I liked the way...
